summary: A new price that carries no times: after Tradesmart's snapshot with its feed time (ft), trade time (ltt) and change (pc), a partial with only a new lp keeps them, as does a partial with only a new volume. A tf is a partial update: a key it leaves out has not changed (the review's R107-10, withdrawn for partial-update feeds).

notes: A tf leaves out what has not changed: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. The web's cache gives the same frames.
Client a holds Quote and client b LTP on one touchline subscription.

deviations.reason: The stream carries no OI for this instrument (a cash equity or an index); the web's TradeSmart adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
